title: Control Flow Practice 1
statement:
Module 2 (Control Flow) covers: flexbox, css grid, positioning, responsive design, pseudo-classes and pseudo-elements, css variables, transitions and animations. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 1: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (Flexbox).
hints: Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
